decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Converting Monthly Royalty History Into a Valuation Baseline
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 4cc74029733ace842907d69e8ab006b47516c4ce6eec67189cf058ad04abcb30; all 8 declared official sources passed live access review.
Statement fields remain bounded to Texas statute; tax-appraisal, tax-administration, public-production, and benchmark-price claims remain bounded to their official sources.
The article uses no fabricated statement figures, production history, price, decimal, tax result, title fact, testimonial, underpayment conclusion, or owner-specific value conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 91, including Sections 91.402 and 91.502 (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Natural Resources Code Sections 91.402 and 91.502 address payment timing and specify statement information including property identification, sales period, volume, price, taxes, deductions, net value, and owner decimal.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The statute supports the statement-field and payment-context discussion; it does not establish title, an owner-specific amount due, or a valuation conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas production data (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission describes operator-reported Texas oil and gas production resources, monthly ledgers, and production query tools.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The source can support a dated production-context check but not title, owner decimal, private pricing, deductions, or a particular owner payment.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas downloadable oil and gas data sets (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission lists downloadable well, field, permit, and production data resources and their data context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The source provides public research inputs and does not prove private payor accounting, title, future production, or owner-specific value.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Manual for Discounting Oil and Gas Income (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller manual documents an income-discounting framework for Texas oil and gas property-tax appraisal, including production, price, expenses, taxes, decline, reserves, discounting, and risk.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves that property-tax context and does not present the manual as a private-sale pricing rule or owner-specific valuation.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller crude oil production tax (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller explains current crude-oil production-tax administration, rates, fees, exemptions, and reporting context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The source supports preserving taxes as a separate worksheet field and does not decide an individual owner statement or tax position.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller natural gas production tax (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller explains current natural-gas production-tax administration, rates, fees, exemptions, and reporting context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The source supports tax context and does not establish how every payor must present an owner statement or how an owner should report taxes.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration petroleum and other liquids data (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: EIA publishes dated petroleum production and price data, including historical price series and market summaries.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The source provides broad market context and does not prove a property-level realized price, deduction, or future price.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration natural gas data (accessed 2026-08-11)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: EIA publishes dated natural-gas price, production, reserves, and drilling data for market context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The source does not establish a property-level realized price, payor accounting result, or future cash flow.
